en: The image shows a historical colored photograph of a large, ornate building with classical architecture, likely a school, surrounded by trees and a fence. In the foreground, people in early 20th-century attire are walking along the street. The postcard has three blue postage stamps on the right side, each featuring a portrait of a man and the word 'БЪЛГАРИЯ' (Bulgaria) in Cyrillic script. At the top left, there is text in three languages (German, Bulgarian in Cyrillic, and Bulgarian in Latin script) indicating the building is the 'Mädchen-Gymnasium' (Girls' High School) in Varna.
